# Unlayer

> Unlayer is an API-first, embeddable content builder platform offering white-label email, page, document, and popup builders for SaaS and enterprise applications.

Unlayer provides drag-and-drop, no-code content creation tools designed for seamless integration into SaaS platforms, CRMs, and enterprise systems. The platform emphasizes security (SOC 2, GDPR compliance), developer-friendly APIs, and rapid deployment to accelerate customer implementations.

## Key Topics

- Email Builder
- Page Builder
- Document Builder
- Popup Builder
- API-First Architecture
- White-Label Solution
- Drag-and-Drop Editor
- Embeddable
- SaaS Integration
- SOC 2 Compliance
- GDPR
- No-Code
- Content Creation
- Enterprise Security
- Cloud API

## Core Products

- [Email Builder](https://unlayer.com/email-builder): Embeddable, white-label email builder with drag-and-drop interface and API-first design for SaaS and CRM platforms
- [Page Builder](https://unlayer.com/page-builder): Embeddable page builder with white-label customization and SOC 2 compliance for landing pages and content creation
- [Document Builder](https://unlayer.com/document-builder): White-label document builder with PDF generation and API-first architecture for automated document creation
- [Popup Builder](https://unlayer.com/popup-builder): Embeddable popup builder with drag-and-drop editing and SOC 2 compliance for conversion optimization

## Enterprise & Deployment

- [Enterprise Solutions](https://unlayer.com/enterprise): Enterprise-grade platform with SOC 2, GDPR, SAML, OAuth, and advanced security features for regulated industries
- [Pricing Plans](https://unlayer.com/pricing): Flexible pricing with Cloud API access and AI-assisted writing features for content creation
- [Home](https://unlayer.com): Unlayer homepage showcasing embeddable email, page, and document builders for SaaS applications

## Industry Solutions

- [Marketing & CRM](https://unlayer.com/solutions/marketing-crm): Solutions for marketing and CRM platforms including email campaigns, landing pages, and popup builders
- [Finance & Payments](https://unlayer.com/solutions/finance-payments): Solutions for finance and billing platforms with invoice generation and document creation capabilities
- [Healthcare & Wellness](https://unlayer.com/solutions/healthcare-wellness): HIPAA and GDPR-compliant solutions for healthcare platforms and patient communications
- [Events & Hospitality](https://unlayer.com/solutions/events-hospitality): Solutions for event platforms including invitations, event pages, and guest communication tools
- [Education & Learning](https://unlayer.com/solutions/education-learning): Solutions for education platforms with LMS integration and student engagement content creation
